# anthropic_environment (Data Source)

Get information about a single Managed Agent Environment by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_environment" "example" {
  id = "env_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Environment.

### Read-Only

- `allow_mcp_servers` (Boolean) Whether MCP servers are reachable from the Environment.
- `allow_package_managers` (Boolean) Whether package managers are reachable from the Environment.
- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) Hosts allowed for network egress from the Environment.
- `apt_packages` (List of String) apt packages installed in the Environment.
- `cargo_packages` (List of String) cargo packages installed in the Environment.
- `config_type` (String) Configuration type of the Environment.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Environment was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the Environment.
- `environment` (Map of String) Environment variables set inside the Environment.
- `gem_packages` (List of String) gem packages installed in the Environment.
- `go_packages` (List of String) go packages installed in the Environment.
- `init_script` (String) Init script run when the Environment starts.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the Environment.
- `name` (String) Name of the Environment.
- `networking_type` (String) Networking type of the Environment.
- `npm_packages` (List of String) npm packages installed in the Environment.
- `pip_packages` (List of String) pip packages installed in the Environment.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Environment was last updated.
